passages.title: How to Get a Digital Library Card
text: The City Library now offers a free digital library card. With this card, members can borrow e-books and audiobooks through the library's mobile app. Follow these steps to get your card.
1. Download the PustakaKota app from your phone's app store and open it.
2. Tap Register and enter your full name, date of birth, and email address. Students under 17 must also enter the name and phone number of a parent or guardian.
3. Take a clear photo of your identity card or student card and upload it. Make sure all four corners of the card can be seen and the text is easy to read.
4. Create a password of at least eight characters. Use a mix of letters and numbers.
5. Check your email. The library will send a six-digit code within ten minutes. Enter the code in the app to confirm your email address.
6. Wait for approval. The library staff usually check new registrations within one working day. When your card is approved, it will appear on the app's home screen.

You can borrow up to five e-books at a time for fourteen days. E-books return automatically when the loan period ends, so there are no late fees. If you have problems, visit the help desk on the ground floor or send a message through the app.

passages.title: Wedang Jahe (Hot Ginger Drink)
text: Wedang jahe is a traditional Javanese drink that is perfect for rainy evenings. Many people believe it helps to warm the body and relieve a sore throat. This recipe makes four cups.

Ingredients
100 grams of fresh ginger
2 stalks of lemongrass
2 pandan leaves, tied in a knot
100 grams of palm sugar, chopped
1 litre of water
a pinch of salt

First, wash the ginger well. You do not need to peel it, but cut off any dry or dirty parts. Then burn the ginger over a gas flame or grill it for a few minutes until the skin is slightly black. This gives the drink a stronger, smoky flavour.
Next, crush the ginger with a pestle or the side of a heavy knife. Do the same with the white part of the lemongrass.
After that, put the water, ginger, lemongrass, and pandan leaves in a pot. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and let it simmer for fifteen minutes.
Then add the palm sugar and salt. Stir until the sugar has completely melted. Taste the drink and add more sugar if you like it sweeter.
Finally, strain the drink into cups and serve it while it is still hot. You can store the rest in the refrigerator for up to three days and heat it again before drinking.

questions.question: What should be put in the container first?

options.A: A layer of dry leaves or cardboard

questions.explanation: Langkah 2: Start with 10 cm of dry leaves, straw, or torn cardboard (lapisan cokelat).

questions.question:
Classify each material as a brown layer or a green layer according to the infographic.
(1) Torn cardboard
(2) Banana peels
(3) Coffee grounds

options.A: (1) Brown layer; (2) Brown layer; (3) Green layer
options.B: (1) Brown layer; (2) Green layer; (3) Brown layer
options.C: (1) Brown layer; (2) Green layer; (3) Green layer
options.D: (1) Green layer; (2) Green layer; (3) Green layer

questions.explanation: Lapisan cokelat: daun kering, jerami, kardus sobek. Lapisan hijau: kulit buah dan sayur, ampas kopi, rumput segar. Kulit pisang adalah kulit buah.

questions.question: Why should each green layer be covered with a brown layer?

options.A: To make the compost ready faster
options.C: To keep rats away from the meat

questions.explanation: Langkah 4: Cover each green layer with a brown layer to stop bad smells. Daging sama sekali tidak boleh dimasukkan.

questions.question:
A user has finished all six steps, but the card does not appear on the home screen after one hour. Which conclusions are reasonable?
(1) The staff may not have checked the registration yet.
(2) The user must pay a late fee first.
(3) The user can ask for help at the help desk or through the app.
(4) The user must download a different app.
questions.explanation: Pemeriksaan biasanya dalam one working day, jadi satu jam belum tentu cukup (1). Bantuan tersedia di help desk atau lewat pesan di aplikasi (3). Tidak ada denda, dan tidak disebut aplikasi lain.

questions.question: How many cups of wedang jahe does the recipe make?
questions.explanation: This recipe makes four cups. Angka tiga merujuk pada lama penyimpanan (tiga hari).

questions.question: What is the purpose of burning the ginger?

options.C: To give the drink a stronger, smoky flavour
options.D: To make the ginger easier to wash

questions.explanation: This gives the drink a stronger, smoky flavour. Teks juga menyebut jahe tidak perlu dikupas.

questions.question: When should the palm sugar be added?

options.B: After the drink has simmered for fifteen minutes
options.C: After the drink is strained into cups
options.D: At the same time as the pandan leaves

questions.explanation: Urutan: rebus air dengan jahe, serai, dan pandan lalu didihkan 15 menit (After that), baru Then add the palm sugar and salt.

questions.question: The word strain in the last step means ....

options.A: to pour liquid through a filter to remove the solid parts
options.B: to heat liquid until it boils
options.C: to mix liquid quickly with a spoon
options.D: to keep liquid cold in a refrigerator

questions.explanation: strain the drink into cups: menyaring minuman agar ampas jahe, serai, dan pandan tertinggal.

questions.question: The text says Many people believe it helps to warm the body and relieve a sore throat. How should a reader treat this information?

options.A: As a scientific fact proven in the text
options.B: As a common belief that the text does not prove
options.C: As the main step of the recipe
options.D: As a warning not to drink wedang jahe

questions.explanation: Kata Many people believe menunjukkan kepercayaan umum. Teks tidak memberikan bukti ilmiah, jadi pembaca menganggapnya klaim, bukan fakta yang dibuktikan.
